research_question: Can neighboring tensile-strength knowledge repair chemical-system OOD prediction of MPEA yield strength after the experimental state and the donor-to-target physical relation are represented explicitly?
claim_guard: This experiment was designed after outcomes from the earlier aggregate MPEA benchmark and other transfer screens had been inspected. It is method development, not prospective or confirmatory evidence. A favorable local result can justify a frozen Balam run; it cannot replace independent external validation.

planned_state.description: Covariates available when a tensile test is planned or declared.

characterized_state.description: Adds characterization available after synthesis but before the mechanical endpoint is measured.

leakage_controls: No elemental system may cross development and evaluation.
Predicted UTS for a target-training fold is generated by a donor model that excludes every elemental system in that held fold and all evaluation systems.
The final donor model excludes every evaluation elemental system.
The shuffled control permutes donor outcomes before every donor-model fit.
Measured UTS is reported only as a separate auxiliary-measurement ceiling on paired rows.
ood_definition: Evaluation elemental systems are ranked by median nearest-neighbor composition distance to the actually labelled target-training set; intact systems form Q1 through Q4.
